20030501.text: According to the letter, this should be the place.

20030502.text: Sorry, we don't serve the general public. I'm afraid you'll have to leave.

20030503.text: Wait! We're not the general public...

20030504.text: Well then... you must be a couple of wandering outlanders that snuck into the nation... judging by your attire.

20030505.text: Are our clothes really so— oh! Uh... What Paimon means to say is—

20030507.text: Hmm, the Yashiro Commission's seal... this must be from Mr. Thoma. It seems there's more to you than meets the eye.

20030508.text: In which case, welcome to the Komore Teahouse, a safe haven for the Yashiro Commission.

20030509.text: Well, that sounds more like it.

20030101.text: Well, now that we're here, where's Thoma?

20030102.text: *sigh* Paimon doesn't see him anywhere, do you think he forgot his promise to meet us?

20030103.text: Who forgot their promise? I was beginning to think you'd forgotten about me!

20030104.text: Wh—Wh—What!? Is that dog talking to us!?

20030105.text: Hahaha, relax, no need to look so surprised. I take it this is the first time you've seen me in this form?

20030108.text: Huh, so you didn't see anything like this when you were in Liyue Harbor?

20030109.text: Ah, now that you mention it, this does suddenly seem less out of the ordinary...

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the Statue of the Omnipresent God

20030201.text: This area sure feels gloomy. People probably don't come here often, do they?

20030202.text: Huh, are Paimon's eyes playing tricks, or are there things embedded in the statue...?

20030204.text: Visions! You mean all the Visions that are collected from the Vision Hunt Decree are put into this statue!?

20030205.text: So you've already heard of the Vision Hunt Decree.

20030206.text: Why did the shogun issue the Vision Hunt Decree?

20030207.text: Before I try to explain, I should perhaps remind you first that Mondstadt is the City of Freedom, and Liyue is the City of Contracts...

20030208.text: As for Inazuma... It's known as the Nation of Eternity.

20030209.text: The Raiden Shogun is both the nation's most powerful ruler, and its deity.

20030210.text: The "eternity" in question... is her endless and unchanging will to rule over Inazuma.

20030211.text: As such, she relies on the Tri-Commission to regulate the nation's affairs, and the Sakoku Decree to limit the people's movement.

20030212.text: The shogun wishes to keep Inazuma in stasis, allowing the stream of time to flow from one end to the other without disturbing it, for all time.

20030213.text: Seems like every god has their own will...

20030214.text: Of course, this is my own limited understanding. As for the reason behind the recent Vision Hunt Decree...

20030215.text: Perhaps the shogun believes that Visions grant people the power to change, and that her eternity doesn't allow for such instability to exist.

20030216.text: Whatever the case, the fact is that the Raiden Shogun has dispatched the Tenryou Commission to scour the nation for Visions, embedding each one in this statue...

20030217.text: ... and this Statue of the Omnipresent God can be seen as Inazuma's symbol of eternity.

20030218.text: But if that's the case, wouldn't you say that the Raiden Shogun is being... I don't know, selfish?

20030219.text: Haha, only outlanders such as yourselves would ever dare speak out so directly against the Raiden Shogun.

20030220.text: And yet... I agree. The Vision Hunt Decree is something that simply should not exist, and Miss Kamisato has been committed to fighting it since the day it was announced.

20030221.text: #Huh? {NICKNAME}, are you okay? You look like your mind is elsewhere.

20030222.text: Sound? What sound? I didn't hear anything... did something happen?

20030223.text: What was that... sound just now?

20030224.text: Yeah, you touched the statue, and then... and then what?

20030225.text: I could hear the sound of... people's aspirations.

20030227.text: Hmm... That would seem to confirm the saying.

20030228.text: Have you heard it before? That when a person's ambition reaches a certain strength, the gods look upon them with favor.

20030229.text: That is where Visions come from... In other words, a person's Vision represents their ambition.

20030230.text: So, if what you just said is true...

20030231.text: ...then the ambitions of these people are stronger than I imagined.

20030232.text: So a Vision symbolizes ambition, and not power...

20030233.text: Alright. Time for the next stop on our tour of Narukami Island: the Kamisato residence.

20030401.text: So this is the kind of place where the big shots of Inazuma live, huh? Paimon kinda expected it to be... snazzier.

20030404.text: Welcome, at last, to the Kamisato residence, honored guests. Miss Kamisato is delighted to finally meet you.

20030405.text: Is this the Shirasagi Himegimi you keep going on about? So, uh, where's she at?

20030408.text: Yes, haha, as the daughter of the Yashiro Commission, this is how Miss Kamisato is accustomed to receiving guests.

20030409.text: Consider it a time-honored tradition within the Yashiro Commission. Forgive me if this is an unwelcome surprise.

20030601.text: Miss Kamisato's left, it seems. No cutting corners, now, okay?

20030701.text: It's been quite some time since I've seen anyone show up with a new Invitation Letter. I wish you two luck.

414143202.text: I wrote a little when the inspiration hit, but I feel like... Um, this is rather embarrassing...

414143203.text: Mind reading it out to me?

414143204.text: Sure! As... as long as you don't laugh... heh.

414143205.text:
"You and I
Like the stars and moon
The wind and the clouds
Like flowers and mist
Never shall we part."

414143206.text: H—How is it... Will it do?

414143209.text: Is that so? Hmm, I thought so too... I've got to practice more so that I can write Marla a better poem.

414143210.text: Thanks! I'll make some edits before handing this in. Please give me a while more, Professor Venti!

414143302.text: Oh, you mean the homework that Professor Venti gave us...

414143303.text: Don't worry about it! Even though preparing a gift for Barbara-sama is my top priority, creating a poem filled with passion is just as important!

414143304.text: Let me show you the power of a fan's heart!

414143305.text:
"No further distance in this world below
Wider even than life and death
Than that of the Cathedral window
You within — I, outside left"

414143308.text: *sigh* It seems that you lack spirit — you still do not understand the regard in which we hold Barbara-sama.

414143309.text: But it's fine, you have much time ahead of you. Good luck, Traveler!

414143310.text: Let me give this a bit more thought and come up with a better version, and then I can submit it to Professor Venti.

414143402.text: Oh, you mean the love poem I'm writing for Master Jean! I—I'm still working on it!

414143403.text: Professor Venti was teaching us tricks for writing love poems, yes, but what I'd like to express is more like admiration and yearning.

414143404.text: I did write a poem, but I haven't had the time to send it to the Professor just yet... Would you like to hear it?

414143406.text: "Your earnest profile working\nLike the moon in the night sky gleaming\nIt leads me into restful dreaming"

414143407.text: How is it? Will it do?

414143410.text: Really? That's great! That's exactly what I'd like to express!

414143411.text: Thank you! I'll make a few more improvements, and then I'll hand it in.

414143502.text: See you. Come back and challenge this domain again if you have the time.

414143601.text: Do you know about any of the other activities?

414143602.text: Hmm, for this, you can go look for Lizzie. She's always introducing fun events to people during the Windblume Festival.

414143603.text: I hope that you'll enjoy yourself, too!

414143702.text: This is a special domain that was discovered by the Adventurers' Guild some time ago. It seems to only turn up at specific times.

414143703.text: There are quite a few interesting things going on inside. We've opened it to the public after some modification work.

414143704.text: If you're interested, please feel free to attempt this challenge. Do it alone, or call your friends, either is fine!

414143705.text: It's not dangerous in there, is it?

414143706.text: Don't worry, we'll have seasoned adventurers accompanying you all the way if you bring people without any experience.

414143707.text: But I think that a veteran such as you will be fine.

414143801.text: Give it a go! This is the special festive event that the Adventurers' Guild has prepared for everyone.

414144002.text: I'm in charge of welcoming guests, and of organizing all sorts of fun activities for everyone during the Windblume Festival.

414144003.text: A lot of the events are being held outdoors due to the large area needed, so without a guide to tell them where things are happening, lots of people are going to miss out!

414144004.text: And I, Lizzie, am glad to step up to that plate!

414144006.text: There are three events taking place during the festival: "Bullseye Balloons," "Floral Freefall," and "Ballads of Breeze".

414144007.text: As for the details... As opposed to having me explain, I think it might be easier if you try them out yourself.

414144008.text: As long as the preparations for the activity have already been made, I can tell you where they're being held.

414144009.text: May you have a happy Windblume Festival!

414144011.text: I've heard that the Adventurers' Guild has something special up their sleeve for the Windblume Festival.

414144012.text: If you're interested, I'd advise you to look for an adventurer named Plauen. He'll tell you all about it!

414144101.text: Hey there! Having fun this Windblume Festival?

414144201.text: *sigh* I wonder how Glory is doing...

414144202.text: I wish I could return to Mondstadt to see her... But I can't. How can I let her know that her lover is a coward and a deserter?

414144203.text: The best I can do now is clear out monsters and do my part to protect Mondstadt... and her.

414144204.text: Laugh if you want. I'm... I'm a useless man.

414144301.text: This is the time of the Windblume Festival, the season when dandelions float about in the wind.

414144302.text: I've always been looking forward to a time when I might express my love for my destined one amid a sea of billowing dandelions...

414144303.text: But I never expected Miss Patchi to be too absorbed in her research to understand a thing I was saying...

414144304.text: Nothing could be more boring than spending such a romantic festival buried knee-deep in books ruins.

414144305.text: Who knows how long it'll take for her to understand these deep yet nebulous feelings of mine...

414144401.text: What sort of flower is a "Windblume"? The one who solves this particular enigma will certainly leave their mark on the academic world.

414144402.text: And that's why some researchers have teamed up with adventurers to search for clues as to the "Windblume"'s identity.

414144403.text: Unfortunately, they haven't made much headway.

414144404.text: But we won't give up! We will find that true "Windblume." That is our solemn duty as researchers!

414144405.text: Speaking of which, Mr. Doolan often tells me that we should go to Cape Oath to have a look. What a curious idea. It's not as if there are ruins there or anything...

414144502.text: Indeed. No matter which camp you belong in, remember to enjoy this hard-earned freedom that we possess.

414144601.text: What camp do you belong to?

414144602.text: Me? I don't put much importance on what sort of flower the "Windblume" actually is.

414144603.text: I'm a researcher and writer who studies history and culture. I must maintain a neutral stance...

414144604.text: ...Opinion is the great enemy of scholarship.

414144605.text: But if you find any documents or material of historical value, you're welcome to discuss them with me.

414144702.text: Yes. They are also known as the "Windblume Traditionalists."

414144703.text: As opposed to a celebration of romance, they believe that the Windblume Festival is more about commemorating the liberation of Old Mondstadt from tyranny.

414144704.text: As far as I'm aware, "Windblume" was possibly once a code word for people who wished to stay in contact and plot resistance in secret...

414144705.text: But most people have forgotten this layer of meaning, and so those who feel that this festival should stand for the liberation of Mondstadt have become the minority.

414144706.text: Windwheel Asters bear the title of "the visible winds," and so the traditionalists have chosen it to represent them.

414144801.text: Hmm, you're not celebrating the festival in the city. Are you, by any chance... an Asterist?

414144901.text: The Windblume Festival... Hmph, it's that time of the year again, is it?

414144902.text: I had an epiphany when I got divorced, and it was like waking from a long dream: the Windblume Festival should never have been associated with love at all!

414144903.text: Hah, it must have been the scheme of some scheming city merchants. Wouldn't they love to package every festival as something for lovers?

414144904.text: ...People in love have no rational thought to speak of. A little flattery here and there and their wallets open wide.

414144905.text: Whatever the case, I've come to my senses now. These festivals are absolutely meaningless.

414144906.text: ...And if not for the Windblume Festival, would I even have met that man? Hmph...

414145001.text: It's Windblume Festival again... I suppose the Windblumes must be dandelions, after all.

414145002.text: No matter how strong the wind, it can only blow dandelions away, but it will never cause them to perish.

414145003.text: But this is just my opinion. But it may be for this reason that dandelions became the symbols of love.

414145004.text: I hope... I hope that our love will be just as resilient.

414145202.text: Oh! As Springvale hunters, this is one of our customs.

414145203.text: Every Windblume Festival, young hunters like me go to Wolvendom to catch foxes.

414145204.text: When we catch one, we place a wreath of flowers on its head and release it. It's a prayer for finding love in the year ahead...

414145205.text: Of course, only eligible young hunters like myself participate. Hunters that have already tied the knot, like Draff for example, they're not allowed to take part.

414145207.text: *sigh* Not even close. Foxes are so hard to catch.

414145208.text: I didn't catch one last Windblume Festival either. In fact, I nearly injured myself. I remember swearing that this time would be different...

414145209.text: ...and yet, low and behold, I've been outfoxed again. All I caught were a couple of squirrels.

414145210.text: That said... I wonder if Miss Sucrose could use her bio-alchemy to change squirrels into foxes?

414145213.text: Uh... if you always participate, your chances will increase exponentially...

414145214.text: ...in that sense, you're bound to bump into the right person eventually...

414145215.text: ...ahem. Anyway, that's what Draff's always telling us.

414145301.text: Foxes really are too difficult to catch. Just how exactly did the elders manage it...

414145401.text: #Hey there, {M#amigo}{F#amiga}! Are you here to listen to Six-Fingered José's latest composition?

414145402.text: Hehe, fear not. My creations do not disappoint.

414145403.text: When it comes to the Windblume Festival, other bards think love songs. Madre mía, no sense of invention...

414145404.text: I, Six-Fingered José, on the other hand, am not constrained by convention. I wish to eulogize the heroic epics of ages past! The people must remember that this is a day for commemorating heroes and resisting tyrants!

414145405.text: Even if, ahem... I haven't quite finished the last part yet. But once it's complete, it will bring my audience running back!

414145501.text: Huh? I recognize that voice... Traveler?

414145502.text: The Windblume festivities are in full swing! If you get time, do make sure to roam around. You'll find a very different Mondstadt.

414145503.text: Even better, if there's someone important to you, you should spend the festival with them. That's where the Windblume feeling truly resides...

414145504.text: I always used to spend the Windblume Festival with my family and my darling Godwin. How I cherish those sweet times...

414145505.text: I still don't know how he's getting on... May the winds protect him.

414145601.text: I'm afraid I don't know either...

414145602.text: Hmm... I wonder how Barbara-sama will react when she sees our gift...

414145702.text: Not a bad choice, but if it's just an ordinary letter then it'll be forgotten in no time...

414145703.text: Hmm, the content has to be different from a normal letter, we need something unforgettable...

414145802.text: Flowers... a—as a matter of fact... we at the Barbara Fan Club already have a similar idea.

414145803.text: Sending flowers the old-fashioned way would be too boring, better to come up with something a little more... unique...

414145901.text: I hope Barbara-sama will like what we've prepared...

414145902.text: ...*sigh* Traveler, what kind of gift do you think moves people the most?

414146102.text: The Windblume Festival had a very solemn meaning once...

414146103.text: But nowadays, many people believe that it's just a time when they send flowers to others and get their feelings across.

414146104.text: Oh? Have someone you'd like to send flowers to, do you? Let me guess... is it me, by any chance?

414146105.text: ...Haha, don't be so nervous. I was just joking.

414146201.text: Since it's the Windblume Festival, would you like to come to The Cat's Tail and have a few drinks?

414146202.text: I might even give you some flowers... Hehe.

414146301.text: Marla, the Windblume Festival is here, and yet, it holds no meaning for me...

414146303.text: We do not have your father's approval, but this time for lovers is ours also...

414146304.text: No, what I mean is that as long as I am with you, every day may as well be the Windblume Festival.

414146305.text: You're right, Marvin. Our love is like the dandelions that bloom on Cape Oath...

414146306.text: Marla, no... Our love should not be a thing so fragile...

414146307.text: No, I mean to say that though the dandelions are scattered by the wild winds, their lives will not thusly end.

414146308.text: Dandelion Seeds will fly to distant places, take root, and sprout there... One day, they will cover the length and breadth of Teyvat.

414146401.text: I'll leave you to it, then.

414146402.text: Yes, alright. Please don't disturb me any further...

414146502.text: I... I have a friend. Yes, a friend...

414146503.text: He's very taken with a certain girl, but unfortunately, she doesn't come from a particularly wealthy family, so my friend's rather worried that his father will oppose their marriage.

414146504.text: Thing is, he truly loves that girl and wants her to be his wife.

414146505.text: So I... well, he, is wondering if he should simply come clean with his father...

414146507.text: Ahem! *cough* D—Don't you say such scurrilous things...

414146508.text: Wait a moment, you haven't been sent by the old man to test me, have you?

414146509.text: Hmph, whatever. I said nothing. Just go.

414146512.text: *cough* Ah, uh. I said nothing. You didn't hear anything from me!

414146601.text: Ugh, should I tell my father or not?

414146602.text: No, I suppose it would be best if I didn't. But if I don't tell him, I...

414146801.text: Not going to see the sights?

414146802.text: Wh—What? I couldn't possibly do that. I've been tasked by a diplomat to guard the embassy. How could I just desert my post?

414146803.text: *cough* And even if I did want to go for a stroll, I'd have to wait for there to be no one about...

414146804.text: ...Hey. Don't you even think of getting me to talk. I won't shirk my duties!

414146902.text: That Viktor keeps saying that this place is as boring as ever, but I can certainly feel the festive atmosphere.

414146903.text: I'll have you know that I take the greatest pleasure from watching the dejection of those imbeciles who confess their feelings come the festival, only to be rejected. Hah...

414146904.text: *cough* But back on topic, there's one thing that I don't get...

414146905.text: ...How did this commemorative festival become a day for lovers, anyway?

414146906.text: Is this what the people of Mondstadt call "freedom"?

414147001.text: Mondstadt only really gets interesting during festivals, anyway...

414147101.text: Nowadays, no one truly knows what the Windblume is.

414147102.text: There are some who have judged that the flower simply does not exist, save in legend and song only.

414147103.text: The way I see it, Windblumes are real so long as there are those who believe in it.

414147104.text: As to which flower it might be, I think that everyone is free to decide that for themselves.

414147105.text: I believe that this "freedom to choose" is what Lord Barbatos would have wished for us to have...

414147201.text: Nowadays, no one truly knows what the Windblume is.

414147202.text: There are some who have judged that the flower simply does not exist, save in legend and song only.

414147203.text: The way I see it, Windblumes are real so long as there are those who believe in it.

414147204.text: As to which flower it might be, I think that everyone is free to decide that for themselves.

414147205.text: I believe that this "freedom to choose" is what Lord Barbatos would have wished for us to have...

414147302.text: A youngster like you should be more energetic. Don't be cold!

414147402.text: Ah, the Windblume Festival has its origins in Old Mondstadt and the days of the Lord of the Tower. Nowadays, no one knows what the Windblume truly is.

414147403.text: And that is why we explore ancient ruins to uncover the history of resistance in those days. We wish to uncover the truth behind the Windblume.

414147404.text: It is a shame that few young people agree with our views...

414147405.text: If you ask me, the Windblume Festival should be about recounting the era of the Tower of Storms, and the legend of that heroic rebellion, haha!

414147502.text: This is a day to remember those heroes who fought for their freedom. It is said that they once used Windblume as their code word...

414147503.text: As to which flower the Windblume really is? Ah, there are as many views as there are people.

414147504.text: To commemorate the courage and sacrifice of those heroes, we go out to search for clues regarding the Windblume each time the festival rolls back around.

414147505.text: Over many years of searching, I have come to believe more and more that the Windblume is the Windwheel Aster!

414147507.text: Yes! Don't you think so, too?

414147508.text: Compared to the dandelion, the Windwheel Asters that turn with the wind are the true symbol of Mondstadt's freedom and the soul of the Windblume Festival!

414147509.text: It's just that we lack concrete evidence with which to convince other people...

414147601.text: Well then! It's the Windblume Festival. What do you say to going to Stormterror's Lair to search for clues regarding the Windblume?

414147802.text: When we speak of the Windblume Festival, the topic of the Windblume's legend is an inevitable one.

414147803.text: The Windblume Festival has its origins in Old Mondstadt, and people all have their own opinions concerning the true identity of the Windblume.

414147804.text: At the moment, the two most popular must be the "Dandelionite" and "Asterist" schools of thought.

414147805.text: Of course, there are those who believe that neither of these is the true Windblume...

414147807.text: Oh, they believe that the Dandelion is the Windblume. I believe that this is the most mainstream line of thinking.

414147808.text: The Dandelionites believe that the Windblume Festival is a festival for lovers and that they should express their love with the most extravagant sincerity during this time.

414147809.text: Passionate people in love will often travel to Cape Oath and express their feelings for one another amid the billowing Dandelions and profuse Cecilias...

414147810.text: It's all rather romantic, wouldn't you say?

414147812.text: Those who believe that the Windwheel Aster is the Windblume are certainly not few, but they are not as numerous as those who believe it is the Dandelion.

414147813.text: They believe that the liberation of Old Mondstadt from tyranny should be at the heart of the festival...

414147814.text: ...And that instead of celebrating love, this festival is more suited to remembrance.

414147815.text: If you think about it, this view does have its merits as well...

414147816.text: But it isn't the majority. I guess people just want to have a relaxing, good time during the festive season...

414147901.text: Welcome to Mondstadt — make sure you don't miss out on the Windblume Festival.

414148001.text: I've got other things to attend to.

414148002.text: I see. Be careful out there.

414148102.text: Oh, my, if it isn't the Windblume Festival again. The youth of the city have come out to play.

414148103.text: Haha. I wonder what flower shall be offered up to the Anemo Archon this year? Will it still be a Dandelion?

414148104.text: When I was a young man, I used to enjoy debating the identity of the Windblume as well. I was quite the dyed-in-the-wool Dandelionite.

414148105.text: Come to think of it, my wife and I met during the Windblume Festival. It was truly love at first sight...

414148106.text: *sigh* How the years have gone by since then...

414148201.text: #Excuse me, {M#sir}{F#ma'am}? ...Oh, er, I mean hey there, friend! Why, this work mode of mine... So, care for a chat?

414148402.text: Ah, it's just a shame. Mondstadt is so... well, it's peaceful, but maybe it's too much so.

414148403.text: *sigh* If only I'd been born in the days of Old Mondstadt *hic* ...just maybe...

414148404.text: How is one to become a hero in such days of peace?

414148406.text: Well, that certainly was an opportunity, but...

414148407.text: Wait. Are you trying to ask me what I was doing during the Stormterror Crisis?

414148408.text: I... I'll have you know that I was doing a sweeping survey of all of Mondstadt's safety blind spots!

414148409.text: *cough* I mean, it's all water under the bridge now, isn't it? Let's not dredge it up anymore, hahaha...

414148411.text: I... well... I mean, Snezhnaya is, after all, an ally of Mondstadt's...

414148412.text: I couldn't possibly cause a diplomatic incident just like that, could I?

414148413.text: *cough* I guess I should just find some other way to do this...

414148501.text: Ah, the Windblume Festival... How I envy those heroes who left their mark on history...

414148601.text: I wonder who will have the honor of offering the Windblume to Lord Barbatos this year?

414148602.text: Ah, I'm so envious. If only I could be the one. Everyone's eyes would be on me...

414148603.text: (And who knows? Maybe Diluc might notice me if I'm the one offering flowers...)

414148604.text: (That would be so wonderful... Oh gosh, he's all I can think about, isn't he...)

414148702.text: I hope you'll enjoy yourself during the Windblume festivities.

414148802.text: The Windblume Festival is an ancient tradition of Mondstadt's. A day for freedom and romance.

414148803.text: When we speak of Windblume Festival tradition, I suppose it's about giving the "Windblume" in your heart to the person who's the most important to you, hehe.

414148804.text: As to what flower the Windblume actually is, everyone's got their own opinions.

414148805.text: Well, that's freedom for you, hehe.

414148901.text: I'd like to buy some flowers.

414148902.text: Certainly. We have a fine selection, whether you're looking to give a bouquet to someone or even do some gardening yourself.

414149001.text: Welcome to Floral Whisper. Are you looking to get someone a bouquet? It's the Windblume Festival, after all.

414149102.text: Take care, and make sure to enjoy the Windblume Festival!

414149201.text: About the Windblume Festival and adventurers...

414149202.text: A lot of couples will choose to have dates at Cape Oath, but there are some brave adventurer couples who will venture near Stormterror's Lair.

414149203.text: That area is simply crawling with monsters, so many adventurers will come here to purchase new equipment...

414149204.text: ...After all, if you were to be beaten by monsters in that place, you wouldn't just lose face — you'd be putting your companion in danger, too...

414149205.text: So each time the Windblume Festival rolls around, we smiths run brisker business than usual, so I suppose we can be thankful for that.

414149301.text: What do you have to sell?

414149302.text: Take your pick from this selection. All Master's own handiwork, so you won't find any second-rate items here.

414149401.text: Well, by the looks of you, I'd say you're an adventurer! Not going to stock up on some new equipment?

414149604.text: Ever since the Windblume Festival began, she's been bugging me about Cape Oath and heart-shaped Sunsettias...

414149605.text: Sunsettias of that kind just don't exist...

414149703.text: That's right. I'm Quinn of Quinn's Fruit. My booth is at...

414149704.text: Fresh fruits only at... Quinn's Fruit...

414149801.text: Even if she's a close friend, my resolve won't be shaken... *hic*

414149901.text: I'm being serious, there really are heart-shaped Sunsettias around Cape Oath...

414149902.text: Bea, your eyes must have been playing tricks on you. Sunsettias just don't grow into that shape. It's against the laws of nature.

414149903.text: And even if they did exist, there's no way that they could be sweeter than the ones I'm already selling.

414149904.text: Well, why don't we just go over to Cape Oath to have a look? It won't take long...

414149905.text: No. This has to do with my convictions! Using visual attraction to sell fruit is just a cheap trick. I would never do that.

414149906.text: ...Oh come on, why won't you just get it already...

414149908.text: *cough* Uh, nothing... Come on, just consider it for a second!
